title: Email warehouse when stock is low
description: As a warehouse manager I want an email when an item's stock falls below its reorder threshold so that I can restock before it sells out.
acceptance_criteria: When stock drops below the item's reorder threshold, one email is sent to the warehouse inbox
The email lists SKU, item name, current stock, and threshold
No further email is sent for the same item until stock goes back above the threshold
If the email fails to send, the failure is logged and retried once
